business.description: Priya Limited reported no revenue from operations in FY 2025-26 and FY 2024-25. The company earned a profit of Rs. 434.40 Lakhs in 2025-26 primarily due to a notional gain of Rs. 803.39 Lakhs from the auction of office premises by the bank, with no business operations during the financial year.

auditor.name: JM & Associates
key_audit_matters: Company's account declared as Non-Performing Asset (NPA) and received notice under Section 13(4) of SARFAESI Act for symbolic attachment of properties; accumulated losses exceed net worth resulting in negative net worth; bank accounts blocked; revenue from operations nil; branches closed and assets written off/sold in FY 2020-21; summons received from DRT Mumbai by three lender banks.

Properties in Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai auctioned by Bank; auction proceeds information unavailable as of 31st March 2026; accounting adjustment between outstanding borrowings and value of assets sold recognized in current year; properties of Brent Properties Investment Pvt. Ltd. and Cheshire Properties Investment Pvt. Ltd. auctioned by Indian Bank for Rs.4.56 crore each (identified via Form 26AS FY 2024-25); Company's properties under collateral securities auctioned by Indian Bank for Rs. 9.03 crore (identified via Form 26AS).

For year ended 31st March 2026, loss of ₹90.25 lakhs for quarter and profit of ₹434.50 lakhs for year; profit primarily due to Exceptional Items notional gain of Rs. 803.39 lakhs from auction of office premises by bank; no tax provision made on auction gain; management relies on Income Tax judgments that capital gains tax not applicable where capital asset appropriated towards security/guarantee and consideration not received by owner.
Bank of Maharashtra, Indian Bank and Union Bank of India declared company, promoters, directors and corporate guarantors as wilful defaulters; management has represented against the same.

During previous financial year, Company deposited Rs.175 lakhs in 'non-lien account' with Indian Bank as part of proposed One-Time Settlement of Rs. 22.81 crores including realization from auction of properties.
Auditor reassessed going concern; audit evidence supports management's use of going concern basis; financial statements reflect reasonable and fair assessment.

Aggregate provision of Rs. 3,953.81 lakhs for doubtful debtors (expected credit loss) as of March 31, 2026 relating to export sales; Management has not approached RBI & FEMA for approval of writing off; unable to comment on impact on profit/loss or net worth.
Casual vacancy for CFO w.e.f. 1st December 2022; Company could not appoint within prescribed six months; unable to comment on penal consequences impact.

VXL Instruments Limited (CIRP commencement 26.11.2024) and VXL Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (CIRP commencement 26.02.2025), both related parties, initiated CIRP under IBC 2016; may affect Company's financial position and future transactions.

Notional interest of ₹357.05 lakhs recognized during year ended March 31, 2026 on NPA accounts; cumulative outstanding interest payable ₹2,763.82 lakhs as of 31st March 2026; no bank statements or confirmations obtained for NPA accounts regarding interest rates including penal interest; unable to determine accuracy and completeness of interest provision and outstanding liability; financial statements may be materially misstated in respect of finance costs and borrowings.

outlook.statement: The company has again approached a consortium of three banks for one-time settlement letter dated November 26, 2024, discussion is in process. The company has deposited 1.75 crore in "No Lien Account" with Indian bank out of proposed Rs.22.81 crore as one-time settlement.

The Company does not presently foresee any immediate revival of its business operations. The future outlook would depend substantially upon the successful resolution of its outstanding liabilities and the resulting ability to revive its business operations.

The Company does not foresee any significant business opportunities in the immediate future. The Company's primary focus remains on resolving its outstanding financial obligations and pursuing appropriate settlement arrangements with its lenders.
